ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels; white pixels represent approximately <10% of total surface area, primarily localized in thin linear streaks and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black/dark-grey background across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity white geometric blobs are clustered at the distal tips. Multiple high-contrast white linear streaks are distributed non-uniformly, with higher density on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible acute V-shaped central depression; the vertex is positioned slightly above the turbulent water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire visible trailing edge; amplitude of variations is greater on the distal portions of both lobes, appearing as a series of jagged peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature characterized by an upward and outward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters are detected at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating localized surface disruption.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions; includes multiple parallel diagonal lines (rake marks) on the right lobe and isolated vertical/diagonal lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense distribution of linear scars (rake marks) across the visible ventral surface. Irregular, high-contrast scarring and possible minor tissue loss at the terminal ends of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, singular vertical white linear mark is visible on the lower-left section of the fluke, near the intersection with the water surface.
